title: 미국 시장과 한국 시장

summary.definition: 미국과 한국 시장은 통화·금리·산업 구성·회계·투자자 기반이 달라 같은 글로벌 충격도 다른 기업 현금흐름으로 번역된다.
summary.mechanism: 미국의 달러 유동성과 한국의 수출·외국인 흐름·원화 환율이 서로 연결되지만, 시장 규모와 공급망 위치가 반응을 다르게 만든다.
summary.example: 미국 AI 인프라 CAPEX 증가는 한국 부품 수요를 늘릴 수 있지만 고객 집중·가격·환율·국내 CAPEX 위치가 국내 기업의 실제 이익을 결정한다.
summary.counterScenario: 미국 기업의 주가 상승을 한국 공급업체의 이익 증가로 바로 옮기면 계약 구조·재고·환율·지분 희석을 놓친다.

researchEvidence.statement: The FRED Inflation Expectations release provides separate series for expected inflation and real interest rates across maturities; the release is a data reference and does not make the measures interchangeable.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Series frequency, maturity, observation date, construction method, and revisions must be preserved; no current value is embedded in this article fact.

researchEvidence.statement: Investor.gov describes Form 10-K as containing the business description, risk factors, MD&A, and audited financial statements; the sections answer different questions and should be read together.
researchEvidence.invalidation: A 10-K is not a complete valuation, a forecast, or proof that management's narrative will occur; the filing date and reporting period must remain explicit.

researchEvidence.statement: KRX distinguishes ETF, ETN, and ELW as listed securities products with different legal and economic structures; a listed product should not be treated as identical to the underlying asset or index.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Product terms, issuer credit, leverage, tracking, liquidity, fees, and applicable rules must be read from the current product documents; this is not a product recommendation.

researchEvidence.statement: NIST AI RMF Core groups AI risk work into Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage. Governance is cross-cutting, while the other functions are applied throughout the AI lifecycle; the framework is voluntary and use-case agnostic.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Do not treat the framework as a legal requirement, a model-quality guarantee, or evidence that a particular system is safe.
